title: HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01 Postdoctoral Fellowships
summary: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships 2026 support researcher mobility and postdoctoral projects, including research areas covered by Euratom and ERA Fellowships routes for widening countries.
reality_check: Continue only where a named candidate, a named supervisor, and a developed proposal already exist; a general institute-wide expression-of-interest round is now too late.
action_note: Apply a hard go/no-go test to each candidate-host pair within days.

title: ERC Advanced Grant 2026
summary: Frontier-research funding for established principal investigators with a strong track record and ambitious scientific vision.
reality_check: Expected to open on 28 May 2026 and effectively restricted to truly exceptional senior PIs; do not treat as a speculative broad call.

title: Euratom Research and Training Programme 2026-2027
summary: The 2026 Euratom call includes topics on operating nuclear facilities and research reactors, SMRs and advanced reactors, nuclear materials and coolants, fuel and safety, and stable isotopes and precursors for nuclear medicine.
reality_check: UJF should no longer attempt to coordinate a proposal from scratch. Participation is realistic only through an existing consortium with a defined task, work package, budget, and expected result.
action_note: Continue only confirmed consortium roles; close speculative entries.

title: DIGITAL Europe Large-Scale Pilots for AI and GenAI in Medical Imaging
summary: Digital Europe call line for large-scale deployment pilots of AI and GenAI tools in medical imaging workflows.
reality_check: Relevant mainly through clinical and data-hub partnerships; UJF impact is strongest when positioned on physics-informed methods and validation.

title: OP JAK - Top Research
summary: Large-scale Czech calls aimed at research excellence, capacity building, and development of major scientific teams and infrastructure.
reality_check: Relevant for institutional growth, but this is mainly a planned institutional track that needs internal prioritization long before launch.

title: GA CR Postdoc Individual Fellowship
summary: Individual postdoctoral funding scheme in the Czech Republic.
reality_check: Worth watching as an expected individual route for incoming candidates, but it still depends on a very strong applicant profile and confirmed call timing.

title: OP JAK - Vyzkumne infrastruktury II
summary: Planned OP JAK call for modernization and development of large research infrastructures, expected around October/November 2026-March/April 2027 with a planned 1.9 billion CZK allocation.
reality_check: Potentially crucial for UJF if it has a recognized large-RI role or a concrete modernization package; preparation should not wait until the call launch.
action_note: Prepare the technical wishlist and institute-level prioritization now, before the October/November window.

title: OP TAK - Aplikace: mezinarodni spoluprace
summary: OP TAK call supporting industrial research and experimental development in international cooperation.
reality_check: Partner-only opportunity for UJF in practice; proceed only with a clear business-driven industrial research or experimental-development case and at least one foreign partner.

title: OP TAK - Partnerstvi znalostniho transferu IV
summary: OP TAK knowledge-transfer call for company-research cooperation, with up to 12 million CZK eligible costs and a required knowledge-transfer assistant.
reality_check: Useful for detector, measurement, and material-process transfer, but not a good route for purely basic research without a concrete company use case.

title: OP JAK - Teaming-CZ III
summary: OP JAK Teaming-CZ III supports development of excellent research centres linked to successful Horizon Europe Teaming pipelines.
reality_check: Very high institutional fit only if UJF is already in a qualifying Teaming for Excellence pipeline; otherwise feasibility is effectively low.

title: OP JAK - Vyzkumne e-infrastruktury II
summary: Planned OP JAK call for research e-infrastructures, expected around November 2026-March/April 2027 with a planned 600 million CZK allocation.
reality_check: Relevant only through a clear e-infrastructure, HPC, data-service, or service-provider role; otherwise keep as a B-level watchlist item.
action_note: Keep only if UJF can name an e-infrastructure, HPC, or data-service role.

title: MSMT - Program EXCELENCE
summary: Expected MSMT programme for strengthening excellent research teams and institutional research capacity.
reality_check: Strategically relevant, but the report did not find a final public call text; treat as monitoring until full competition documents are published.

title: GA CR - Swiss-Czech Lead Agency Projects 2027
summary: GA CR Lead Agency route for Swiss-Czech basic-research projects, with SNSF deadline on 1 October 2026 and Czech submission due by 8 October 2026.
reality_check: High fit for physics, materials, space, and nuclear experiments where a Swiss PI and coherent joint proposal already exist.
action_note: Use only where a Swiss PI and coherent joint proposal already exist; otherwise shift effort to later preparation.

title: HORIZON-MSCA-2026-DN Doctoral Networks
summary: MSCA Doctoral Networks 2026 are open from 28 May 2026 with a 24 November 2026 deadline for international doctoral training consortia.
reality_check: Strong fit for nuclear data, detectors, radiochemistry, radiation protection, materials, or space instrumentation, but only for a consortium that already has a scientific theme and core partners.
action_note: Confirm the coordinator, core partners, training concept, and UJF role.

title: IAEA CRP F23037 - Radiation-Induced Structural Changes in Polymers
summary: IAEA coordinated research project on data-driven prediction of radiation-induced structural changes in polymers.
reality_check: Good fit for materials-in-radiation expertise, but CRP budgets and proposal details need checking on the individual IAEA record.

title: IAEA CRP I31037 - Numerical Simulation of STELLA-2 Transient Experiments
summary: IAEA coordinated research project on numerical simulation of transient experiments at STELLA-2.
reality_check: Relevant for nuclear-safety modelling groups, with feasibility depending on specific modelling capacity and experiment alignment.

title: IAEA CRP I31043 - V&V of Design Tools for Molten Salt Reactors
summary: IAEA coordinated research project on experimental testing for verification and validation of molten-salt-reactor design tools.
reality_check: High fit for safety and experimental-validation capacity, but participation should be checked against the detailed CRP technical scope.

title: IAEA CRP I31042 - Ex-Vessel Corium Cooling
summary: IAEA coordinated research project on ex-vessel corium cooling from PIRT to accident management.
reality_check: Strong fit for severe-accident and safety expertise, but less relevant for teams focused only on basic nuclear physics.

title: AV CR PCP 05/2026 - Podpora cinnosti pracovist AV CR
summary: Main AV CR internal support package for UJF-relevant instruments such as Lumina quaeruntur, Praemium Academiae, PPLZ, ERC-in, Akademie budoucnosti, AV21, and related institute requests.
reality_check: Main AV CR envelope for UJF planning: new requests are due 12 October, change requests 26 November, and circuit 6 by 8 December 2026; one internal harvest should cover the package.
action_note: Set up one internal candidate-harvest table for LQ, PA, PPLZ, ERC-in, Akademie budoucnosti, AV21, and related requests.

title: AV CR - Akademie budoucnosti 2026
summary: AV CR career-support instrument for junior and senior research stays, good-practice exchange, and returns after career breaks.
reality_check: High practical value for UJF because it can be used through internal institute selection; collect concrete stay and return candidates early.
action_note: Collect concrete stay, return, and good-practice-exchange candidates through the PCP harvest.

title: AV CR ERC-in - Podpora predkladatelu projektu ERC
summary: AV CR support for employees preparing ERC proposals, including mentoring, consultations, interview preparation, and related costs.
reality_check: Small-budget but high-leverage route for building a disciplined ERC pipeline at UJF; useful only for PIs with a realistic ERC profile.
action_note: Use only for PIs with a realistic ERC target and align candidates with the PCP harvest.

title: AV CR - Lumina quaeruntur 2026
summary: AV CR excellence instrument for developing an independent scientific team and research programme.
reality_check: Potentially strong fit for UJF only where there is a candidate with a clear independent programme, international profile, and institute co-financing capacity.
action_note: Screen only candidates with a credible independent programme and institute co-financing path.

title: AV CR - Praemium Academiae 2026
summary: AV CR elite support for outstanding senior researchers and their directly related scientific activity.
reality_check: Use only for genuinely exceptional senior PI candidates; this is not a broad group-leader support tool.
action_note: Keep selective; use only for genuinely exceptional senior PI candidates.

title: AV CR PPLZ - Postdoktorandi 2026
summary: AV CR PPLZ postdoctoral support for early-career researchers at AV CR institutes.
reality_check: Practical personnel-pipeline tool for UJF postdocs shortly after Ph.D.; strongest when tied to a concrete research plan and host group.
action_note: Collect postdoc candidates in the same PCP table, tied to host group and research plan.

title: AV CR - Strategie AV21 2026
summary: AV CR strategic programme platform with 15 running programmes in 2026 and selection of four new programmes expected for financing from 2027.
reality_check: Use through AV21 programme logic rather than as a normal grant; strongest UJF angles are space, nuclear technologies, radiation safety, data, and medical applications.

title: AV CR - Regionalni spoluprace 2026
summary: AV CR regional cooperation line for projects with concrete regional or local partners.
reality_check: Relevant for UJF only when there is a real regional partner and applied case, such as radiation monitoring or environmental measurement.

title: Horizon Europe Space 2026
summary: Horizon Europe Space 2026 includes topics relevant to radiation-hard components, FPGA technologies, space instrumentation, high-energy testing, and radiation effects on electronics and materials.
reality_check: Proceed only where an existing consortium has assigned UJF a concrete role or work package; general interest without a consortium should leave the 2026 pipeline.
action_note: Confirm consortium, UJF role, deliverables, and budget immediately.

title: TA CR SIGMA DC2 - Industrial Chairs 2026
summary: TA CR SIGMA DC2 Industrial Chairs supports research organisations in recruiting and retaining internationally recognised applied-research experts and their teams. The call has a 500 million CZK allocation, up to 42 million CZK per project, and a maximum aid intensity of 60%.
reality_check: Only viable for UJF if the expert, institutional framework, and most of the proposal are already prepared; starting from zero two days before the deadline is unrealistic.
action_note: Submit only a nearly finished proposal; otherwise make an immediate no-go decision.

title: ERC Proof of Concept 2026
summary: ERC Proof of Concept cutoff for validating or preparing use of results from eligible ERC grants.
reality_check: Relevant only if UJF has an eligible current or recent ERC result with credible validation or exploitation potential.

title: ERC Plus Grant 2026 Watchlist
summary: Expected new ERC Plus Grant scheme for exceptionally strong PIs, reportedly up to 7 million EUR for 4-7 years.
reality_check: Strategically interesting but extremely selective; track only for a genuinely top UJF candidate.

title: COST Open Call 2026
summary: COST Open Call 2026 accepts proposals from 31 July to 28 October 2026 and will fund up to 80 new four-year COST Actions. It supports research networks, meetings, workshops, training, mobility, and coordination, but not the underlying research costs.
reality_check: A proposal must involve at least seven COST Full or Cooperating Members, at least 50% of the participating countries must be Inclusiveness Target Countries, including Czechia, and at least 40% of proposers must be Young Researchers and Innovators under 40. One person may be a Main or Secondary Proposer in only one proposal.
action_note: Before preparing a new Action, also screen the 80 CA25 networks launching in autumn 2026; researchers can join their Working Groups after launch.

title: EIC Transition 2026
summary: EIC Transition 2026 supports maturation and validation of technologies based on eligible EU-funded results, with grants up to about 2.5 million EUR.
reality_check: Relevant only when a candidate technology is based on an eligible result from a prior EU project such as ERC Proof of Concept or Pathfinder/FET. Without a verified parent result, further proposal analysis is not useful.
action_note: Verify the eligible parent result before any further proposal work.

title: EIC Pathfinder Challenges 2026
summary: EIC Pathfinder Challenges 2026 are topic-gated calls for high-risk deep-tech research.
reality_check: Track only if a published challenge directly matches a concrete UJF technology; do not bend basic physics into deep-tech framing.
action_note: Monitor challenge fit, but do not push without a direct technology match.

title: Eurostars Call 11
summary: Eurostars Call 11 funds market-oriented international R&D led by an innovative SME; the consortium must include at least two independent organisations from at least two Eurostars countries.
reality_check: UJF can participate as a research partner for detectors, radiochemical technologies, medical instrumentation, or radiation measurement, but an innovative SME must lead.
action_note: Proceed only with an SME lead, market route, and complete international consortium.

title: TA CR THETA 2 - 4th Public Competition
summary: The fourth THETA 2 public competition is planned for announcement on 26 August 2026, with applications expected from 27 August to 21 October. Its three subprogrammes cover public-interest energy research, competitive energy technologies, and long-term energy sustainability.
reality_check: This is the strongest prepared national call for UJF. A research organisation can lead, but the required application guarantor or company involvement depends on the selected subprogramme.
action_note: Prepare one-page concepts now with subprogramme, PI, problem, applied result, partner or guarantor, budget, and nuclear-energy link.

title: OP TAK STEP - Research and Development of Critical Technologies
summary: OP TAK STEP supports industrial research and experimental development of critical technologies in digital and deep tech, clean technologies, biotechnology, and defence, with grants of 10-150 million CZK per project.
reality_check: UJF can participate only as a partner of an enterprise. The technology must be at least TRL 4 before the project and pass the STEP innovation or strategic-dependency test.
action_note: Shortlist only technologies with TRL 4+, a company applicant, strategic EU value, and a credible market or security use.

title: European Partnership on Metrology - Normative Call 2026, Stage 2
summary: The 2026 Normative Call Stage 2 includes SRT-n10 on risk-aware type-testing requirements for radiation-protection dosimetry and implementation of new radiation-protection quantities.
reality_check: The thematic fit is unusually precise, but Stage 2 is not suitable for a late standalone entry. UJF needs a route through CMI or an existing EURAMET consortium.
action_note: Immediately ask CMI or the SRT-n10 consortium whether UJF can still join.

title: JRC ActUsLab Open Access 2026 - FMR, PAMEC and HC-KA
summary: JRC ActUsLab offers access to specialised facilities for actinide materials, plutonium and minor actinides, advanced fuels, molten salts, transmutation, spent fuel, and radioactive-waste research.
reality_check: This is access to JRC infrastructure rather than a cash grant. JRC-operated infrastructure is listed at 0 EUR per access unit, while travel support depends on available resources.
action_note: Contact the relevant JRC facility early to confirm technical feasibility.

title: ERC Starting Grant 2027
summary: ERC-2027-STG is a bottom-up frontier-research call for researchers with 0-10 years of experience since PhD. The call budget is 594.1 million EUR for an estimated 373 grants; each grant offers up to 1.5 million EUR for five years, plus up to 1 million EUR in justified additional funding or up to 2 million EUR for relocation from a non-associated third country.
reality_check: High value only for an identified PI with a mature idea and credible excellence profile. Under the 2027 rules, an applicant may receive no more than one Starting and one Consolidator Grant during their career, may submit only one proposal under the 2027 work programme unless the first is declared ineligible, and may normally have only one proposal under evaluation at a time.
action_note: Check eligibility against 1 January 2027, prior ERC grants, and concurrent evaluations; prepare the new five-page Part I around the core scientific idea before developing Part II methodology and implementation.

title: GA CR-ISF Lead Agency Call 2026
summary: GA CR and the Israel Science Foundation plan their first joint Lead Agency call in September 2026, open to all fields of basic research and evaluated by ISF.
reality_check: Worth monitoring only for existing Czech-Israeli scientific relationships; without an Israeli PI there is no actionable UJF pipeline entry yet.
action_note: Map existing Israeli collaborations and wait for the full call conditions.

title: European Nuclear Skills Initiative 2026
summary: HORIZON-EURATOM-2026-NRT-01-01 supports the European Nuclear Skills Initiative, including groundwork for a Nuclear Skills Academy, targeted training, regulatory expertise, and mobility programmes.
reality_check: Fit is limited to a mature European consortium for systematic education and skills retention; a standalone set of UJF training activities is insufficient.
action_note: Continue only with a concrete European education consortium and defined UJF role.
